7.2.6.3 Vehicle State Manager
Vehicle State Manager
is collecting states from the several vehicle
ECU
s and in-
forms
UCM Master
when the safety state computed based on the safety policy re-
ferred in the
Vehicle Package
is changing. If the safety policy is not met, the
UCM
Master
can for instance decide to:
•
Inform vehicle driver that the safety conditions are not met to continue the update
•
postpone, pause or cancel the update until policy is met
